name: scan-bridge
description: Scan Bridge — drive a USB/network scanner from a web page. server/ = the bridge, web/ = the panel, packaging/ = the single-file apps.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix packaging install
scripts.exe:win: npm run build:web && npm run bundle && node packaging/pkg.mjs win
scripts.exe:mac: npm run build:web && npm run bundle && node packaging/pkg.mjs mac-arm && node packaging/pkg.mjs mac-x64
scripts.exe:linux: npm run build:web && npm run bundle && node packaging/pkg.mjs linux
scripts.exe:all: npm run build:web && npm run bundle && node packaging/pkg.mjs
